title: Kusikiliza na Kujibu (Theme 1: Usafi wa sehemu za umma)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child plans what to say, listens to the end, and replies on the topic in standard Kiswahili with the features of a mahojiano.
steps: Reply on the topic with a reason.
Keep the language and the turn-taking right.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child takes part in a short mahojiano on the topic while a partner ticks the checklist.

misconceptions.ask: Swali hili litampa mhojiwa nafasi ya kueleza?

listen_for: swali la kwanza moja kwa moja
misconceptions.repair: Anza kwa salamu, jitambulishe, eleza lengo.

misconceptions.ask: Ni maneno yapi si ya Kiswahili sanifu?
misconceptions.repair: Tumia Kiswahili sanifu katika mazungumzo rasmi.

checks.question: Ni swali lipi bora la mahojiano?
checks.answer: Kazi yako ya kusafisha mji ina changamoto zipi?
